units.source_text: “我曾经非常秘密地和一个女子交往。

en.t: I once had a very secret relationship with a woman.

units.source_text: 当初并不想到长远之计。

en.t: At first, I had no thought of any long-term plan.

units.source_text: 但是和她熟悉之后，觉得此人十分可爱。

en.t: But after I came to know her well, I found her deeply endearing.

units.source_text: 虽然并不常常相聚，心中总当她是个难忘的意中人。

en.t: Although we did not meet often, in my heart I always regarded her as an unforgettable beloved.

units.source_text: 那女子和我熟悉之后，也表示出想依靠我的意思来。

en.t: After that woman became close to me, she too began to show that she wished to depend on me.

units.source_text: 有时我心中自思：她想依靠我，一定会恨我足迹太疏吧？

en.t: At times I thought to myself: since she wants to rely on me, she must resent how rarely I visit her, must she not?
Then I felt somewhat guilty toward her.

units.source_text: 然而这女子毫无怨色，即使我久不去访，也不把我当作一个难得见面的人，还是随时随地表示殷勤的态度。

en.t: Yet this woman showed no trace of resentment; even if I went a long time without visiting, she did not treat me as someone hard to see, but remained attentive and affectionate at every moment.

units.source_text: 我心中觉得可怜；也就对她表示希望长聚的意思。

en.t: I felt pity for her in my heart, and so I let her know that I wished for us to be together for a long time.

units.source_text: 这女子父母双亡，孤苦伶仃；每有感触，便表示出想依靠我的样子，教人怪可怜的。

en.t: This woman had lost both her parents and was utterly alone; whenever something moved her feelings, she would show that she wanted to depend on me, which made her seem terribly pitiable.

units.source_text: 我看见这女子稳静可靠，便觉放心，有一时久不去访。

en.t: Seeing that she was calm and dependable, I felt reassured, and for a time I went a long while without visiting her.

units.source_text: 这期间，我家里那个人[\[12\]](#part1331.html#m12)吃起醋来，找个机会，教人把些凶狠毒辣的话传给她听。

en.t: During that time, the person at my house[\[12\]](#part1331.html#m12) became jealous, found an opportunity, and had someone pass along some cruel and vicious words for her to hear.

units.source_text: 我是后来才知道这件事的。

en.t: I only learned of this matter later.

units.source_text: 起初我想不到会发生这等烦恼的事，虽然心中常常惦记，却并不写信给她，只管久不去访。

en.t: At first I never imagined that such a troubling thing would happen, and although I often thought of her, I did not write to her and simply continued not visiting for a long time.

units.source_text: 这期间她意气沮丧，更觉形单影只了。

en.t: During this time, her spirits sank, and she felt all the more solitary and alone.

units.source_text: 我俩之间已经有了一个小孩。

en.t: By then there was already a child between the two of us.

units.source_text: 她寻思之余，折了一枝抚子花[\[13\]](#part1331.html#m13)教人送来给我。

en.t: After much brooding, she broke off a spray of pink flowers[\[13\]](#part1331.html#m13) and had someone send it to me.
At this point in his story, To no Chujo shed tears.”
